title: Bril Finance (BSC): permissionless rebalancer keeper on user-held ICHI vaults — no unprivileged extraction
closed_reasons: Vault funds are user-held ERC-20 shares (150 holders; Safe/factory/strategies hold 0 shares); vault owner = Bril Gnosis Safe
vault.rebalance(...) is onlyOwner (owner = Bril Safe); direct attacker calls revert 'Ownable: caller is not the owner'

The permissionless strategy.rebalance()/performUpkeep() path makes the Safe call vault.rebalance(..., swapQuantity=0) — a no-trade re-range; only tiny fee distributions leave the vault (20% ICHI / 80% affiliate)
Execution requires the strategy to be an enabled Gnosis Safe module; only 8 of the 19 ready strategies qualify (others revert GS104), covering just $419.79 of vault value
Two-step execution (rebalanceInitiation + executionDelay 180-900s) + minTimeBetweenRebalances (1-6h) + priceChange/volatility/gas gates
Manipulation economics negative: the executable vaults are worth $0.01-$277.57 while pool depth costs ~$44k notional per 1% move on CAKE/WBNB
Strategy pause/owner/reset functions are owner-only; Wrapper staking contracts are standard MasterChef-style with self-service withdrawals

poc.method: local anvil fork of BSC (read-only on mainnet); three scenario groups verified
scenarios: unprivileged EOA initiate -> wait -> execute a real vault rebalance (tx 0xaef4c2bbcc2f49287db392f06ae51157dcfd38f1e090e960eb7906b08cdd2f1c, status 1, 22 logs incl. Safe ExecutionFromModuleSuccess, 3x UniV3 Burn, vault ranges moved to simulate() plan)
gates: direct vault.rebalance -> 'Ownable: caller is not the owner'; non-module strategy execute -> GS104; pause/unpause/resetStrategy -> owner-only
poc.ci_note: GitHub fork-suite runs were blocked by infrastructure (empty BSC_RPC_URL on the CI repo, pruned pinned block, foundry-toolchain HTTP 500, GitHub/blob network timeouts). The CI ready-scan did complete (block 127504422: 77 strategies / 19 ready, matching 3 local scans). Fork PoC evidence: analysis/fork_poc_evidence.json.
ci_evidence: CI fork suite run 38500971995 (block 127514436): 4/7 passed (architecture+module gate, immediate permissionless execute, t5 initiate->execute with Safe ExecutionFromModuleSuccess and vault re-range to simulate() plan, other types); manipulation tests show the strategy refusing to plan/execute at a manipulated price (volatility guard). Final run with broadened catch blocks dispatched.
CI module scan (all 178 Safe modules): 29 accept rebalance() from a fresh address; every traced execution has vault.rebalance(..., swapQuantity=0) and no pool.swap (ci-out/modules-scan.json)
CI ready scans at blocks 127504422 and 127513681: 77 strategies / 19 ready - consistent with local scans at 127491600 / 127494165 / 127496806

key_facts: Factory 0xfaa2e7c69F7F34195D3Ef6CF98B6B009A6A07F30 (TransparentUpgradeableProxy -> RebalancerFactory 0x6f85eb17955257a39fd78692f6884ebe6531fd8b) registers 9 strategy types / 77 EIP-1167 strategy clones / 48 ICHI vaults
All 77 strategies and all 48 vaults are owned by Bril Gnosis Safe 0x05cC3CA6E768a68A7f86b09e3ceE754437bd5f12 (Safe v1.3.0, 8 owners, threshold 3, 178 enabled modules)
Every strategy is (potentially) a Safe module; strategy.rebalance() has no caller check and makes the Safe call vault.rebalance(...) via execTransactionFromModule

19/77 strategies accept rebalance() from a fresh address (stable across blocks 127,491,600 / 127,494,165 / 127,496,806 / 127,504,422); only 8 of those are enabled Safe modules (execution gate), covering vaults worth $419.79
Traced executions: vault.rebalance(baseLo, baseUp, limitLo, limitUp, swapQuantity=0) — no pool.swap in the rebalance path
ICHI vault source (verified, 0x2b1E2aaBc2dD09ec9E2e667e09705bEC5bd9C40D): rebalance is onlyOwner; deposit/withdraw permissionless; most vaults have deposit0Max=deposit1Max=0 (deposits closed)

Live vault custody ~$114,708.75 (my prices at block 127,496,806; DefiLlama $98,016); ready-19 subset $38,704.42; executable subset $419.79; 150 share holders incl. verified Wrapper staking contracts (stakedToken = the vault shares, reward = CAKE)
Strategy implementations are unverified on BscScan/Sourcify; behaviour derived from ICHI ichi-sdk ABIs, live eth_call probes, debug_traceCall traces and state diffs
All 178 Safe modules were probed on CI: 29 accept rebalance() from an unprivileged address and every traced execution is a no-swap re-range (swapQuantity=0, no pool.swap)
caveats: Strategy implementation source unavailable (unverified); control flow inferred from ABI + traces + state diffs
The Foundry fork suite did not complete on CI due to GitHub/RPC infrastructure issues; equivalent scenarios were proven on a local anvil fork (no mainnet transactions)
129 of the Safe's 178 modules are not in the Bril factory set (other ICHI-vault manager clones); only sampled, not exhaustively audited
Manipulation-PnL bound is analytical + pool-liquidity based (a full flash-swap PnL test is in the CI suite, pending)
Prices from DefiLlama (coins.llama.fi) at 2026-10-14; several vault tokens are illiquid meme/points tokens (MGP/CKP/mCake/SDM) whose realizable value is lower
one_liner: external unprivileged attacker can extract ~$0 live from Bril Finance: the $114.7k of vault value is user-held (H-O), vault rebalance is owner-only, and the only permissionless keeper path is limited to 8 module-enabled strategies managing $419.79 and performs a no-swap re-range via the Bril Safe
